$comment: Story 6.4: high or critical advisories in production dependencies that cannot be fixed without a breaking upgrade. Each entry needs a reason and expires at most 90 days ahead; scripts/audit-check.mjs fails on an expired or unlisted one.

libheif fixes in sharp 0.35.5, a 0.x minor (breaking by semver); same upgrade as GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj.
